desc: Whether you're a competitive shooter, in the market for a new ranch rifle, or just enjoy a superbly accurate rimfire, the Latitude is designed for you. The Latitude has an option in both a fixed stock and a fully adjustable stock for altering the length of pull and cheek height for a personal fit and feel. Our custom carbon fiber stock pairs up perfectly with the Zermatt Arms RimX action. The RimX has become a choice bolt action for some of the top precision competitors and rimfire enthusiast. The RimX action is built to the same scale and footprint of it's larger centerfire counterparts. The Latitude features a world class TriggerTech Special Trigger, 10 round RimX magazine, and our cut-rifled carbon fiber barrel threaded 1/2-28 for your choice of muzzle device. The Latitude arrives ready to perform with our sub 1/2 MOA accuracy guarantee at 50 yards.
